Sweet crab meat bound lightly with mayo, mustard and breadcrumbs, pan-fried into golden cakes, served with a caper and gherkin remoulade and lemon. Mix 400g crab meat gently with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp paprika, 2 sliced spring onions, 60g panko crumbs and lemon zest. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 30g butter and 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 chopped gherkins, 1 tsp Dijon, parsley and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.

Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in peppery flour and fried crackling crisp, with creamy coleslaw and warm buttermilk biscuits with honey. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce. Dredge in 250g plain flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Fry at 160C for 12 to 15 minutes until 75C inside. For biscuits, rub 80g butter into 300g self-raising flour, add 200ml buttermilk, pat out, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220C for 14 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 100g mayo and vinegar.

Chianti stirred with blood orange juice, brandy and a touch of honey, loaded with sliced oranges, apple and cinnamon, poured over ice. In a large jug, stir 750ml Chianti with 200ml blood orange juice, 60ml brandy and 2 tbsp honey until the honey dissolves. Add 1 sliced orange, 1 diced apple and 1 cinnamon stick. Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each. For non-drinkers, make it with sour cherry juice and blood orange juice topped with soda.

s.note: Silky chicken liver pâté and smashed broad beans on toasted baguette
s.how: Fry 1 shallot in 30g butter, add 400g trimmed chicken livers and thyme and cook 4 minutes until just pink inside. Blitz with 100g more butter until smooth and chill. Boil 300g broad beans, peel and smash with oil and salt. Serve both on toasted baguette slices.

s.note: Grated parmesan baked thin and crisp with black pepper
s.how: Grate 150g parmesan finely. Spoon into small wing shapes on 2 lined trays, grind over black pepper and bake at 200C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes so they crisp.

m.note: Lamb shanks braised in red wine, tomato and rosemary until tender
m.how: Brown 4 lamb shanks, then soften 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves. Add 375ml red wine, 400g crushed tomatoes and 2 sprigs rosemary, cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Cook 200g polenta in 1L salted water for 5 minutes, stir in butter and serve the shanks on top.

w.note: Pears poached in red wine with cinnamon and orange peel
w.how: Peel 4 pears, keeping the stalks. Simmer 375ml red wine with 125ml water, 100g sugar, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 strips orange peel, add the pears and poach 25 minutes, turning. Reduce the syrup and serve the pears with 150g mascarpone.

Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each. For non-drinkers, make it with sour cherry juice and blood orange juice topped with soda.
